current_turn_classification: Progress: explicit common-character lattice isomorphism and exact finite-domain readout, with completed symmetry and boundary candidate tests; no whole-query gain.

principal_result: Explicit integral unimodular character normalization and rational ambient lattice-to-lattice isomorphism for equal phase-index classes, with all actual finite-domain and clock lifts retained.

common_character.normalization: C=C0*D with both explicit integer determinant-one Bezout matrices; L=1 handled separately.
common_character.map_scope: Rational ambient determinant-one map, integral and bijective on the supplied source lattice; not claimed as an ambient SL2(Z) or DAHA operator.
common_character.acquired_descriptors: soft O(k), with O(log k) common beta^G directions
common_character.actual_query: q^(h-F_j*n1-Cclock_j*n2)-(beta^G)^n1 on the transported finite parallelogram, n!=0 and h=0..4k.
common_character.canonical_lift_accounting: F_j,Cclock_j obtained from the actual canonical Gauss label row times P_j^-1, not reused from the elementary basis.
common_character.interval_union: Merge actual overlapping/touching intervals; single-cell adjacent intervals merge at |Cclock_j|<=4k+1. Do not fill gaps.
common_character.completed_readout: Enumerate O(k) actual points per cell, soft O(k^2) globally; no huge transformed bounding-box scan.

symmetry.swap: One j->N/j orbit representative with symmetric scale range [8H,N/(8H)] preserves either-factor NONUNIT coverage.
symmetry.count: k/6+O(1) colour families; no net factor-two cell/runtime saving because the logarithmic scale range approximately doubles.
symmetry.enlarged_labels: O(HN+kH), with O(log N) bits and the inherited general extractor interface.
symmetry.sign: Correct signed baseline yields -chi_j and preserves phase index; ordinary -j baseline is different.

literature_specializations.ambient_slope: Whole-lattice kernel congruences modulo k and character congruences modulo H are necessary and sufficient for the specified pointwise covariance; input height charged.
literature_specializations.Dehn_shear: Literal-q covariance forces jprime=j and shear coefficient divisible by H/gcd(j-1,k), including specified half/quarter framings.
literature_specializations.DAHA_A1: Q^(m+n+2*kappa)=1 at kappa=-k/2 pairs source weights j,k-j, but an actual B=2 nonaxis native row has unit-separated node values.
literature_specializations.scope: No general DAHA, matrix, recurrence, or implicit-query lower bound.

boundary_cover.cheap_corner_condition: After literal omissions, true-cell corner hits satisfy an exact integer equation because the index gap has absolute value<16H.
boundary_cover.generator_completion: Old O(k^(3/2)) horizon, soft O(k^(5/4)) query; prior Gauss coverage.
boundary_cover.exhaustive_short_completion: O(k) starts per cell with clock 0..4k; soft O(k^2) whole-family query.
boundary_cover.homothetic_push: Requires ray alignment and scaled clock; not a proved small-corner cover.
